notes: Correct Uniswap LP and fees portfolio network: support Arbitrum One (chainId 42161) as well as Ethereum Mainnet.
Uniswap v3/v4 LP read-only onchain valuation with Arbitrum-specific position manager/state view, ERC20 WETH, native USDC, USDC.e, and USDT addresses and chain-specific RPCs.
Authenticate Ethereum/Arbitrum RPC responses by eth_chainId to prevent attributing wrong-chain balances.
Add network selector and one-tap switch for previously connected wallets; retain public address and existing RUDI wallet ID and avoid stale value carryover.
Show warning when wallet and LP count are zero, including the selected network and address-verification guidance.
Add tests for correct Arbitrum ERC20 addresses, triple WETH/USDC pools, chain mismatch and safe owner-only network switching.
Prepare as one batched change; no production deployment until explicit confirmation.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
